mentions.name: MinusPlus
mentions.description: This app is an infinite canvas calculator where you click anywhere on the canvas and type numbers; pressing space or enter automatically performs the calculation. It supports tagging entries with #, adding comments, and keyboard shortcuts to make calculating efficient.
mentions.problem: The author, an SAP Finance consultant, has to do a lot of calculations daily and found normal calculators insufficient.
mentions.audience: People who do many daily calculations, such as the author, an SAP Finance consultant who uses it for daily work.
mentions.source_excerpt:
I'm working on an interesting infinite canvas calculator called https://minusplus.app/. 
This is an infinite canvas, where you click anywhere and type numbers, 
Press space or enter, and it will automatically calculate.
